index.title: Outreach
index.description: Agents people can reach from a chat app, each through its own linked account.
index.emptyBody: An agent appears here once it has a linked account. Add an agent to give it an account on a chat app.

add.title: Add an agent
add.description: Pick the agent people should reach. Next, you choose a chat app and give it an account there.
add.footnote_one: {{count}} agent has no linked account. Agents are created and edited in Apps.
add.footnote_other: {{count}} agents have no linked account. Agents are created and edited in Apps.

newBot.title: {{agent}} on {{app}}
newBot.description: The account is linked to {{agent}}. You can link it to another agent later.
newBot.name: Account name in {{app}}
newBot.nameHint: People see this name in groups and @mention it.
newBot.scanBody: {{app}} creates the {{bot}} account and links it to Rome.
newBot.replaces: {{agent}} already has {{bot}} on {{app}}. An agent has one account per app, so {{bot}} loses its link, and main answers there until you link another agent.

overview.noBots: {{agent}} has no linked account yet. Give it an account on a chat app, then invite it to any group or DM.

chat.shared_one: {{bots}} is in this chat too. Each agent sees what the chat app delivers to its own account here, which may not include the other agents' replies.
chat.shared_other: {{bots}} are in this chat too. Each agent sees what the chat app delivers to its own account here, which may not include the other agents' replies.
chat.settings: Chat settings: answers when @mentioned · replies in thread
chat.override: Which agent answers: the linked agent. A group can still pick another agent from its settings in the chat app.

activity.description: What was said to and by {{agent}} across its chats, newest first.

settings.introduce: Introduce itself when added to a group
settings.introduceBody: Posts one short hello with what it can help with.
settings.moveConfirm_one: Link {{bot}} to {{to}}? From now on {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chat. The chat and its history stay as they are.
settings.moveConfirm_other: Link {{bot}} to {{to}}? From now on {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chats. The chats and their history stay as they are.
settings.moveReplaces: {{to}} already has {{previous}} on {{app}}. An agent has one account per app, so {{previous}} loses its link, and main answers there until you link another agent.

choose.title: Give {{agent}} an account
choose.description: Pick the chat app. An agent has one account per app.
choose.replaces: Has {{bot}}. A new account here replaces it.

feishu.name: Feishu
feishu.setup: Scan a QR code in the Feishu app
feishu.invite: Open a group, then Settings, Group bots, Add bot, and pick {{bot}}. To start a DM, search for {{bot}} in Feishu. Chats appear here on their own.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.invite: Add {{bot}} to a group from its member list, or search for {{bot}} in Telegram to start a DM. Chats appear here on their own.
telegram.tokenHint: Create the bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste the token it gives you.

discord.name: Discord
discord.setup: Paste a bot token from the Discord Developer Portal
discord.invite: Invite {{bot}} to a server with its install link, then @mention it in a channel. Chats appear here on their own.
discord.tokenHint: Create an application in the Discord Developer Portal, add a bot to it, and paste the bot's token.

wechat.name: WeChat
wechat.setup: Scan a QR code in the WeChat app
wechat.invite: Add {{bot}} to a group from its member list, or message {{bot}} directly in WeChat. Chats appear here on their own.
